units.summary: The recording identifies the IT manager as Yari Kaskila.
units.quote: I'm Yari Kaskila, the IT manager.

units.summary: The meeting notes identify Jari as the one-person IT function.
The IT manager describes himself as the IT department and says his responsibilities span servers, phones and Power BI reports.
units.quote: Which in practice means I'm the IT department. Everything from servers to phones to Power BI reports.

units.summary: The one-person IT function has SQL and Power BI skills, but no Python or machine-learning experience.
units.quote: One-person IT function (Jari). Good SQL and Power BI skills, no Python/ML experience.

units.summary: External partners include the WMS vendor, a Business Central partner and an IT outsourcing provider for network and security.
units.quote: External partners: WMS vendor (support contract), Business Central partner (Dynamics consultancy), IT outsourcing for network and security.

units.summary: The advisors described the operational systems as quite digital, but AI use as individual, with no AI strategy, policy or roadmap.
units.quote: Your operational systems are quite digital, you have a WMS, a TMS, EDI with key customers, but AI use is individual and there is no strategy, policy, or roadmap for it yet.

units.summary: The company implemented a UiPath RPA bot for supplier-invoice matching in Business Central. It handles about 70% of invoices, and the notes characterize it as rule-based rather than AI.
units.quote: An RPA bot (UiPath) was implemented in 2023 for matching supplier invoices to purchase orders in Business Central. Works for ~70 % of invoices; the rest go to manual handling. This is rule-based, not AI, but it is the company's main automation experience.

source.locator: 2. CURRENT USE OF AI AND DIGITAL TOOLS

units.summary: The WMS is on-premise and uses SQL Server.
The TMS has an API that works one record at a time; bulk export is a separate paid service.
units.quote: One technical issue, the TMS has an API, but it only works one record at a time. Bulk export is a separate paid service.

units.summary: The TMS API is limited to single records, and bulk export is available as a paid service.
units.quote: REST API (single records only), WMS, driver mobile app

units.topic: customer master data and reporting infrastructure
units.summary: There is no central data warehouse or shared customer identifier across the WMS, TMS and Business Central; reporting relies on manual Excel exports prepared by the IT Manager.
units.quote: There is no central data warehouse. Customer master data is maintained separately in the WMS, TMS and Business Central, and there is no shared customer identifier between the systems. Reporting relies on manual Excel exports prepared by the IT Manager.

units.summary: The operations team is described as process-savvy and open to change, while supervisors are concerned about extra work during implementation.
units.quote: Operations team is process-savvy and open to change; supervisors are worried about extra work during the implementation.

units.summary: The proposed solution needs to be low-maintenance or operated by a partner because the company has only one IT person.
units.quote: And because you have only one IT person, the solution must be low maintenance, or operated by a partner.

units.summary: The CEO said the board might be open to investing around €60,000–80,000 in AI-related projects if the first pilot shows results.
units.quote: For 2027, I think the board would be open to investing around €60,000-80,000 in AI-related projects, if the first pilot shows results.

units.summary: The company overview says the 2027 budget proposal earmarks EUR 50,000 for digitalisation and AI pilots, with further investment to depend on pilot results.
units.quote: Budget: The 2027 budget proposal earmarks EUR 50,000 for digitalisation and AI pilots, in addition to ordinary IT operating costs (approx. EUR 210,000 per year). Further investment will be decided based on pilot results.

conflicts.description: The meeting recording identifies the IT manager as Yari Kaskila (unit 1), while the meeting notes identify the one-person IT function as Jari (unit 2). The report instructions set no source hierarchy to resolve the discrepancy.

The meeting recording says the board may be open to investing around EUR 60,000–80,000 in AI-related projects in 2027 if the first pilot shows results (unit 14). The company overview says the 2027 budget proposal earmarks EUR 50,000 for digitalisation and AI pilots, with further investment decided based on pilot results (unit 15). The sources do not establish a hierarchy that resolves these figures.
